# Digital Blueprint Marketing

> Digital marketing agency for high-ticket local businesses. Google Ads, Meta ads, creative, websites, local SEO and call-to-invoice tracking with live ROI dashboards.

- [Google Ads + Local Services Ads Management for Local Businesses](https://www.digitalblueprintmarketing.com/services/google-ads/): Google Ads and Local Services Ads managed to booked jobs and signed cases, not clicks. Junk calls disputed, waste blocked weekly, results tied to paid invoices.
- [Facebook + Instagram Ads Management (Meta Ads) for Local Businesses](https://www.digitalblueprintmarketing.com/services/meta-ads/): Facebook and Instagram ads built to stop the scroll and fill your calendar. Lead forms, Reels and retargeting, measured on revenue instead of likes.
- [Call Tracking + Marketing Attribution: Ad Click to Paid Invoice](https://www.digitalblueprintmarketing.com/services/tracking-attribution/): Call tracking, customer record matching and offline conversions that connect every ad to the phone call, the job and the paid invoice. Know exactly what your marketing returns.
- [Offline Conversions + Qualified Lead Signals for Google and Meta](https://www.digitalblueprintmarketing.com/services/qualified-lead-signal/): Teach Google and Meta the difference between a job seeker and a buyer. We send real qualified leads and closed sales back to your ad platforms so they find more people who actually buy.
- [Ad Creative, Video + Photo Production for Local Businesses](https://www.digitalblueprintmarketing.com/services/creative/): In-house video, photo, motion and copy built to stop the scroll and win the click. Creative tested weekly and judged on booked jobs, not likes.
- [Website Design + Landing Pages That Convert for Local Businesses](https://www.digitalblueprintmarketing.com/services/websites/): Fast, sharp websites and landing pages built to turn visits into calls, with every form and call reporting to your pipeline. Built for SEO and AI search from day one.
- [Local SEO, Google Business Profile + AI Search Visibility](https://www.digitalblueprintmarketing.com/services/local-seo/): Win the Google map pack, protect your reviews and show up in AI answers from ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI Overviews. Local SEO built for how people search now.
- [Live Marketing ROI Dashboards for Local Businesses](https://www.digitalblueprintmarketing.com/services/roi-dashboards/): A live dashboard that shows where every marketing dollar went and what it brought back: leads, booked jobs, paid invoices and return by channel. No more spreadsheet reports.
- [Digital Marketing Services for High-Ticket Local Businesses](https://www.digitalblueprintmarketing.com/services/): Google Ads, Meta ads, creative, websites, local SEO and AI search, call tracking and live ROI dashboards, built as one connected system for local businesses.
- [Roofing Marketing + Google Ads for Roofing Contractors](https://www.digitalblueprintmarketing.com/industries/roofing/): Roofing marketing that tracks every lead from the first call to the paid invoice. Google Ads, Local Services Ads, storm campaigns and follow-up that books more roofs.
- [Plumbing + HVAC Marketing, Google Ads + Local Services Ads](https://www.digitalblueprintmarketing.com/industries/plumbing-hvac/): Plumbing and HVAC marketing tied to booked service calls and paid invoices. Local Services Ads, Google Ads and call tracking that matches every call to a real customer.

- [Home Services Marketing: Flooring, Closets, Cleaning, Vents](https://www.digitalblueprintmarketing.com/industries/home-services/): Marketing for home service companies like flooring, custom closets, dryer vent cleaning and pipe lining. Google Ads, Meta ads and tracking that ties every job to its source.
